system.description:
Favoured weapon: Scythe

Granted power: Advantage on saves against instant-death effects. Once/day: touch a willing creature and place it in suspended animation for up to 1 hour: it does not bleed, age, or suffer poison or disease until it ends.

Allegiance: Lawful Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on The Raven Queen in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: hunt one undead or death-cheater until it rests (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
